trips.name: Paris & Rome Foodie Tour
trips.description: A masterfully curated 10-day journey through Paris and Rome, tailored for family with luxury budget priorities.

stops.notes: Focus on foodie experiences in Paris. Top highlights: Eiffel Tower, Louvre Museum, Montmartre, Notre-Dame, Champs-Élysées.

activities.name: Eiffel Tower Summit & Champagne Experience
activities.description: Ascend to the top deck of the iron lady with skip-the-line access and enjoy panoramic views over Paris paired with a glass of French champagne.

activities.name: Louvre Museum Masterpieces Guided Tour
activities.description: Unravel the secrets of the Mona Lisa, Venus de Milo, and Winged Victory with an art historian guide through the world’s largest art museum.

activities.name: Montmartre Secret Bakeries & Pastry Tasting
activities.description: Stroll through bohemian Montmartre sampling warm artisan croissants, delicate macarons, award-winning baguettes, and fine cheeses.

stops.notes: Focus on foodie experiences in Rome. Top highlights: Colosseum, Vatican City, Trevi Fountain, Pantheon, Trastevere.

activities.name: Colosseum & Ancient Roman Forum Underground Tour
activities.description: Access the gladiator arena floor and underground dungeons beneath the Colosseum, followed by an in-depth stroll through the Roman Forum.

activities.name: Vatican Museums, Sistine Chapel & St. Peter’s Basilica
activities.description: Witness Michelangelo’s legendary frescoes in the Sistine Chapel and explore the immense treasures of the Vatican before entering St. Peter’s.

activities.name: Authentic Pasta & Tiramisu Cooking Masterclass
activities.description: Make fresh pasta from scratch alongside an Italian chef in a traditional Roman kitchen, concluding with handmade tiramisu and local wine.

activities.name: Shibuya Night Street Food & Izakaya Crawl
activities.description: Navigate the atmospheric alleyways of Shibuya with a local guide, sampling yakitori, gyoza, ramen, craft sake, and matcha desserts.

cities.name: Paris
cities.description: The City of Light captivates with timeless art, haute cuisine, iconic landmarks like the Eiffel Tower, and charming riverside promenades along the Seine.

cities.name: Rome
cities.description: An open-air museum steeped in nearly 3,000 years of globally influential art, architecture, ancient ruins like the Colosseum, and vibrant trattorias.

cities.name: Barcelona
cities.description: A vibrant Mediterranean seaside city renowned for Antoni Gaudí’s surreal modernist architecture, lively Gothic quarter, and world-class tapas scene.

cities.name: Tokyo
cities.description: A hyper-modern metropolis where neon-lit skyscrapers, historic Shinto shrines, Michelin-starred gastronomy, and cutting-edge tech seamlessly coexist.

cities.name: Kyoto
cities.description: Japan’s cultural soul featuring thousands of classical Buddhist temples, gardens, imperial palaces, traditional wooden machiya houses, and geisha districts.

cities.name: Osaka
cities.description: The culinary capital of Japan, famous for street food like takoyaki, vibrant nightlife in Dotonbori, and centuries-old Osaka Castle.

cities.name: Bangkok
cities.description: An exhilarating capital renowned for ornate shrines, bustling floating markets, street food stalls, river ferries, and vibrant rooftop lounges.

cities.name: Bali
cities.description: Island of the Gods boasting emerald rice terraces, cliffside temples, pristine beaches, vibrant spiritual culture, and tranquil wellness retreats.

cities.name: New York City
cities.description: The energetic heartbeat of culture, finance, Broadway theater, world-class museums, iconic skyline views, and neighborhoods rich in diversity.

cities.name: San Francisco
cities.description: Famous for the majestic Golden Gate Bridge, rolling hills, historic cable cars, Victorian Painted Ladies, and culinary innovation.

cities.name: Rio de Janeiro
cities.description: Sun-drenched coastal marvel framed by dramatic granite peaks, samba rhythms, famous Copacabana and Ipanema beaches, and Christ the Redeemer.

cities.name: Cairo
cities.description: Cradle of ancient civilization where millennia-old Giza Pyramids and the Sphinx overlook the Nile, alongside bustling Islamic bazaars.

cities.name: Dubai
cities.description: An architectural wonderland in the desert with the world’s tallest skyscraper (Burj Khalifa), luxury shopping, desert safaris, and artificial islands.

cities.name: Cape Town
cities.description: Spectacular coastal city where dramatic Table Mountain meets Atlantic waves, penguin colonies at Boulders Beach, and scenic Cape Winelands.

cities.name: Sydney
cities.description: Australia’s shining harbor city featuring the iconic Opera House, Harbour Bridge climb, golden sands of Bondi Beach, and coastal cliff walks.

cities.name: Auckland
cities.description: The City of Sails, situated between two sparkling harbors with dormant volcanic cones, lush rainforest trails, and nearby Waiheke wine island.

cities.name: London
cities.description: A global epicenter of history, royalty, West End theater, world-class free museums, expansive royal parks, and cosmopolitan neighborhoods.

cities.name: Amsterdam
cities.description: Charming city of picturesque canal rings, cycling culture, Rijksmuseum masterpieces, Van Gogh legacy, and historic canal houses.

activities.name: Montmartre Secret Bakeries & Pastry Tasting
activities.description: Stroll through bohemian Montmartre sampling warm artisan croissants, delicate macarons, award-winning baguettes, and fine cheeses.

activities.name: Seine Sunset Dinner Cruise with Live Jazz
activities.description: Cruise along the Seine River aboard an illuminated glass boat enjoying a 4-course French culinary dinner accompanied by live acoustic jazz.

activities.name: Colosseum & Ancient Roman Forum Underground Tour
activities.description: Access the gladiator arena floor and underground dungeons beneath the Colosseum, followed by an in-depth stroll through the Roman Forum.

activities.name: Vatican Museums, Sistine Chapel & St. Peter’s Basilica
activities.description: Witness Michelangelo’s legendary frescoes in the Sistine Chapel and explore the immense treasures of the Vatican before entering St. Peter’s.

activities.name: Authentic Pasta & Tiramisu Cooking Masterclass
activities.description: Make fresh pasta from scratch alongside an Italian chef in a traditional Roman kitchen, concluding with handmade tiramisu and local wine.

activities.name: Sagrada Família Fast-Track Tower Access Tour
activities.description: Marvel at Gaudí’s uncompleted masterpiece with breathtaking stained glass lighting and elevator ride up the Nativity facade tower.

activities.name: Gothic Quarter Tapas & Catalan Wine Tasting Trail
activities.description: Hop between historic taverns in the Gothic Quarter tasting Iberian ham, patatas bravas, gambas al ajillo, and regional cava.

activities.name: Mediterranean Coast Sailing & Swimming Cruise
activities.description: Sail along Barcelona’s skyline on a modern yacht with open bar drinks, snacks, and a mid-sea swim stop in warm Mediterranean waters.

activities.name: Shibuya Night Street Food & Izakaya Crawl
activities.description: Navigate the atmospheric alleyways of Shibuya with a local guide, sampling yakitori, gyoza, ramen, craft sake, and matcha desserts.

activities.name: teamLab Planets Digital Art Immersion
activities.description: Walk through water and become one with giant floating flowers and endless crystal light installations in this world-renowned interactive museum.

activities.name: Mount Fuji & Lake Kawaguchi Day Expedition
activities.description: Full-day scenic excursion to the 5th Station of Mt. Fuji, panoramic cable car above Lake Kawaguchi, and Oshino Hakkai ninja village.

activities.name: Fushimi Inari Torii Gates Dawn Walking Tour
activities.description: Hike through the 10,000 vermilion Torii gates before crowds arrive, discovering hidden mountain shrines and sacred fox statues.

activities.name: Traditional Machiya Tea Ceremony & Kimono Dressing
activities.description: Wear a ceremonial silk kimono and learn the refined ritual of Japanese matcha preparation from a certified Urasenke tea master.

activities.name: Dotonbori Street Food Safari & Takoyaki Workshop
activities.description: Taste Osaka’s soul foods under neon giant billboards and learn how to turn octopus takoyaki balls with wooden skewers.

activities.name: Grand Palace & Wat Arun Sunset Longtail Boat Tour
activities.description: Marvel at glittering golden spires, the Emerald Buddha temple, and glide along narrow canal waterways aboard a traditional longtail boat.

activities.name: Michelin Street Food Tuk-Tuk Midnight Adventure
activities.description: Zip through Bangkok’s illuminated streets in a custom neon tuk-tuk, tasting world-famous Pad Thai, crispy pork belly, and mango sticky rice.

activities.name: Ubud Waterfall, Rice Terrace & Sacred Monkey Forest
activities.description: Trek through lush green jungle valleys, walk among wild macaques, and swing high above the Tegallalang rice paddies.

activities.name: Mount Batur Sunrise Volcano Trek & Hot Springs
activities.description: Hike to the summit of active Mount Batur before daybreak to watch the clouds light up orange, followed by a soak in volcanic mineral springs.

activities.name: Traditional Balinese Spa & Flower Bath Ritual
activities.description: Indulge in a relaxing deep tissue aromatherapy massage, natural herbal body scrub, and an organic tropical flower bath overlooking the river.

activities.name: Summit One Vanderbilt Immersive Observation Deck
activities.description: Step into reflective infinity glass rooms 1,200 feet above Midtown Manhattan with 360-degree views of the Empire State Building and Chrysler Building.

activities.name: Broadway Hit Musical Premium Evening Ticket
activities.description: Experience an unforgettable award-winning Broadway production in the heart of the theater district.

activities.name: Giza Pyramids & Sphinx Camel Safari with Lunch
activities.description: Ride a desert camel past the Great Pyramid of Khufu and the enigmatic Sphinx, led by an Egyptologist guide.

activities.name: Sydney Harbour BridgeClimb Twilight Adventure
activities.description: Scale the iconic steel arches of Sydney Harbour Bridge as the sky turns gold and purple, overlooking the Opera House.

activities.name: Bondi to Bronte Coastal Walk & Surf Lesson
activities.description: Catch your first waves at world-famous Bondi Beach with certified lifeguards, followed by coffee along coastal sandstone cliffs.
